# StrikePoint Sims

StrikePoint Sims is currently paused. The business is exploring options for an indoor golf simulator business in 2027, with the Colchester, Connecticut area still the target.

Whether the project will proceed is undecided. No location or opening date is confirmed. The current homepage offers email updates only, with no reservation or commitment. Previously published membership offers, pricing, equipment plans, and opening dates should not be treated as current plans.

- [Project update and email updates](https://www.strikepointsims.com/)
